Base reusable component layout on local constraints from `LayoutBuilder`
Use `MediaQuery` for view environment data rather than as a substitute for parent constraints
Read only the environmental aspect needed by a subtree when practical
Choose breakpoints where content requires a structural change
Name width classes by layout intent and keep their thresholds centralized
Preserve content priority instead of uniformly scaling the complete interface
Keep adaptive navigation and interaction changes predictable across configurations
Apply `SafeArea` at deliberate screen or region boundaries
Distinguish `padding`, `viewPadding`, and `viewInsets` before adding edge spacing
Make focused fields reachable through scrolling when the keyboard reduces usable space
Treat display-feature bounds as unavailable or separating space according to their type and state
Keep important controls and reading flow away from hinges and folds
Test intermediate sizes, breakpoint edges, split-screen windows, large text, keyboards, and rotation
Preserve state and focus when rebuilding a different responsive composition
